feeds.description: The EJU provides you the best available information on judo events within Europe and the major events of the world. The European Judo Union publishes the best photos, news and keeps you up to date on our calendar. Judo more than Sport.

feeds.title: Kokakids Blog
feeds.description: KokaKids is a Judo Magazine 100% for Kids packed with packed full of judo news, judo info and judo technique. judo resources, judo t-shirts and many more. Our mission is to promote junior judo, and help judo clubs around the world do just that. So children can benefit from Jigoro Kano's incredible sport of judo.

feeds.title: COMBAT JUDO
feeds.description: Combat Judo is a blog dedicated to the practice and philosophy of Judo as a martial art and combat sport. The blog features articles written by experienced Judo practitioners and instructors, covering a range of topics including training techniques, competition strategies, and the historical background of the art.

feeds.title: Judo And Life
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Richard Roper. 'Judo And Life' blog features random thoughts on life, Judo Olympics, Judo Self Defense, The Art or Judo Kata, Judo An International Sport, and things that inspire or annoy me or things that I just had to write down.

feeds.title: The Combat Judo Blog
feeds.description: Barron Shepherd is a 3rd-degree black belt judo instructor and coach (USA Judo), a certified boxing coach (USA boxing), Combat Judo and combative instructor, and certified NASM Sports Performance Enhancement Specialist. Combat Judo is designed to help bridge the gap between sport judo and combat-based judo to ensure that it can be utilized effectively for today's most violent encounters.

feeds.title: Danny Williams Blog
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Danny Williams. I am a full-time athlete and coach at the renowned Camberley Judo Club in Great Britain, represented Team GB at the London 2012 Olympic games and Glasgow 2014 Commonwealth Games gold medallist. I spend my spare time in creative writing, journaling, blogging & vlogging regularly. Each week I compile a shortlist of what I've been finding interesting and useful, on and off of the mat.

feeds.title: The Business/Judo of Life
